I haven't saved the Thornbury draft yet, because it needs approval from June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve first.

Pree is an account manager on the Central team. She doesn't own Thornbury and isn't in finance. Our rules say a per-seat rate can only go to someone like that with June's or Anselm's OK. That applies even to a draft you'll send yourself.

I've asked June in a direct message and logged the approval request. I gave her the subject and the $2,314-a-seat proposed 2027 rate, and said it came from your call with Thornbury yesterday. I've told Marcus the same in his DM.

When June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft in your mailbox to Pree (psundaram@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate." I couldn't find a file showing who owns Thornbury, so I went on your word that it's your account.

In my reply to Marcus I also said he could write the email himself. I shouldn't have: that skips the same approval, so it's best to wait for June or Anselm.
